title.zh: 【Chainlink 推出 24/7 市场数据服务，支持代币化资产交易、永续合约和预测市场等】
title.en: 【Chainlink 推出 24/7 市场数据服务，支持代币化资产交易、永续合约和预测市场等】

current_state.zh: Chainlink launched Chainlink 24/7, an around-the-clock pricing service that supplies weekend and holiday data for stocks and commodities, with Aave's institutional Horizon platform as first partner using it to price tokenized RWA collateral.
